title: Core: Add TTL expiration background task
description:
Implement automatic TTL expiration:
- Background task to expire old reservations
- Clean up messages older than configurable retention
- Can be run by CLI daemon, API server, or standalone
- Add 'mailz gc' command for manual cleanup
- Log expired items

title: API: Add authentication and rate limiting
description:
Add security features:
- API key authentication via X-API-Key header
- Generate API keys per agent
- Rate limiting per agent (configurable)
- Optional: JWT tokens for stateless auth
- Add auth middleware to all endpoints
- Store API keys in database (hashed)

title: Implement core data models
description: Add Agent, Message, FileReservation, Project models to mailz-core with SQLite storage

title: TUI: Implement inbox view
description:
Create main inbox view for the TUI:
- Left pane: folder list (Inbox, Sent, All)
- Middle pane: message list with unread indicators
- Right pane: message preview
- j/k navigation, Enter to open full message
- Mark read/unread with r, acknowledge with a
- Search with / (uses FTS5)

title: TUI: Implement reservations view
description:
Create file reservations management view:
- List active reservations (mine and others)
- Show file path, owner, TTL remaining, exclusive flag
- Create new reservation with n
- Release reservation with d
- Filter by project with p
- Highlight conflicts/expiring soon

title: TUI: Implement agents/projects view
description:
Create agents and projects management view:
- Tab 1: Projects list with agent counts
- Tab 2: Agents list filtered by project
- Show agent status (last seen, message counts)
- Create project with n
- Register agent with a
- Switch between tabs with Tab key

title: Fix install recipe and ensure data directories are created before opening database
description:
Fixed two issues:

1. **justfile install recipe**: The `install` recipe was trying to run `cargo install --path .` on a virtual workspace, which fails. Changed it to delegate to `install-all` which properly iterates through binary crates.

2. **Missing directory creation**: Both `mailz-tui` and `mailz-api` were opening the SQLite database without first ensuring the data directory exists. Added `paths.ensure_directories()?` calls before `Storage::open()`.

Files changed:
- justfile (line 10-11)
- crates/mailz-tui/src/main.rs (line 43)
- crates/mailz-api/src/main.rs (line 48)

title: CLI: Implement file reservation commands
description:
Add commands for file reservations:
- mailz reserve <file>... [--exclusive] [--ttl] [--reason] - Reserve files
- mailz release [<reservation_id>] [--all] - Release reservations
- mailz reservations [--mine] [--file <path>] - List active reservations
- mailz check <file>... - Check if files are reserved

TTL defaults to 30 minutes. Show conflicts when trying to reserve already-reserved files.

title: CLI: Implement messaging commands
description:
Add commands for message operations:
- mailz send <to> <subject> [--body] [--cc] [--bcc] - Send message
- mailz inbox [--unread] [--limit] - List inbox messages
- mailz read <id> - Read a message (marks as read)
- mailz ack <id> - Acknowledge a message
- mailz search <query> [--limit] - FTS5 search messages

Support piping body from stdin for long messages.

title: CLI: Implement agent management commands
description:
Add commands for agent management:
- mailz agent register [--name] [--project] - Register new agent (auto-generates adjective+noun name if not provided)
- mailz agent list [--project] - List agents in project
- mailz agent info <id> - Show agent details
- mailz agent whoami - Show current agent identity

Store agent identity in state dir for persistent sessions.

title: API: Implement REST endpoints for reservations
description:
Add REST endpoints:
- POST /reservations - Create reservation
- GET /reservations - List reservations (filter by agent, file, project)
- GET /reservations/:id - Get reservation
- DELETE /reservations/:id - Release reservation
- POST /reservations/check - Check files for conflicts

Return 409 Conflict when reservation conflicts exist. Include TTL expiry info.

title: Implement MCP server tools
description: Add MCP tools: register_agent, send_message, fetch_inbox, file_reservation, search_messages

title: API: Implement REST endpoints for messages
description:
Add REST endpoints:
- POST /messages - Send message
- GET /agents/:id/inbox - Get inbox
- GET /messages/:id - Get message
- PATCH /messages/:id/read - Mark as read
- PATCH /messages/:id/ack - Acknowledge
- GET /messages/search?q=... - FTS5 search

Support pagination with limit/offset. Add filters for unread, date range.

title: API: Implement REST endpoints for projects and agents
description:
Add REST endpoints:
- POST /projects - Create project
- GET /projects - List projects
- GET /projects/:id - Get project
- DELETE /projects/:id - Delete project
- POST /projects/:id/agents - Register agent
- GET /projects/:id/agents - List agents
- GET /agents/:id - Get agent details

Use axum extractors, return JSON. Add OpenAPI spec.

title: CLI: Add watch/daemon mode
description:
Add background daemon capabilities:
- mailz watch - Watch for new messages, print notifications
- mailz daemon start/stop/status - Manage background daemon
- Daemon can auto-expire reservations based on TTL
- Optional: integrate with system notifications (notify-send, osascript)

title: API: Add WebSocket support for real-time updates
description:
Add WebSocket endpoint for real-time notifications:
- WS /ws/:agent_id - Connect as agent
- Push new message notifications
- Push reservation conflict alerts
- Push TTL expiry warnings
- Handle reconnection gracefully
- Consider using axum's WebSocket support or tokio-tungstenite

title: Implement CLI commands
description: Add CLI: mailz send, mailz inbox, mailz search, mailz reserve, mailz agents

title: CLI: Implement project management commands
description:
Add commands for project management:
- mailz project list - List all projects
- mailz project create <path> [--name] - Create/ensure project
- mailz project info <name> - Show project details
- mailz project delete <name> - Delete a project

Use mailz-core storage layer. Support --json output.

title: TUI: Implement compose view
description:
Create message compose view:
- To/CC/BCC fields with agent name completion
- Subject line
- Body editor (simple textarea, not full vim)
- Tab to switch fields
- Ctrl+S to send, Esc to cancel
- Draft auto-save to state dir

title: TUI: Add real-time updates
description:
Add real-time inbox updates:
- Poll database for new messages every N seconds
- Show notification badge for unread count
- Optional: use file system watcher on SQLite WAL
- Configurable poll interval in config.toml
- Visual indicator when new messages arrive

title: Implement SQLite storage layer
